svg.title: EnvProxy three-layer check
svg.desc: Flow: polled every 2-3 seconds, three gates in order — a local port is listening, the port answers a CONNECT handshake, and one real fetch through it reaches the outside world. Passing all three writes the whole proxy variable set; failing deletes it and returns the terminal to a direct connection.
